scenes.en: Teaching language models to follow instructions with human feedback.
scenes.zh: 用人类反馈教语言模型遵循指令。

scenes.en: Bigger models don't automatically follow what users actually want.
scenes.zh: 更大的模型并不会自动遵循用户真正想要的东西。

scenes.en: They fine-tune GPT-3 in three steps using human feedback.
scenes.zh: 他们用人类反馈分三步微调GPT-3。
scenes.evidence: arXiv:2203.02155 · “Step 1: Collect demonstration data, and train a supervised policy.”

scenes.en: The 1.3B model beats the 175B GPT-3, with 100 times fewer parameters.
scenes.zh: 13亿参数的模型胜过1750亿的GPT-3，参数少100倍。
scenes.label: 1.3B InstructGPT preferred over 175B GPT-3

scenes.en: Labelers preferred InstructGPT outputs 85 percent of the time over GPT-3.
scenes.zh: 标注员有85%的时候更喜欢InstructGPT的输出。
scenes.evidence: arXiv:2203.02155 · “175B InstructGPT outputs are preferred to GPT-3 outputs 85 ± 3% of the time”
scenes.text: 175B InstructGPT outputs are preferred to GPT-3 outputs 85 ± 3% of the time

scenes.en: Human feedback is a promising path to aligning models.
scenes.zh: 人类反馈是对齐模型的一条有希望的道路。
